title: Trading a Calm, Luxurious Living Room
excerpt: Warm minimalism — beige stone, walnut veneer and soft gold lighting layered for a calm, premium family lounge.
body: A full living-room transformation begins with how the family actually gathers. We replan the layout for conversation and light, then add walnut panelling, a marble-media wall and layered cove lighting. The result is a lounge that feels generous without ever feeling loud.

title: The Smart Way to Plan a Modular Kitchen
excerpt: Chef-grade workflow — a tall storage tower, island breakfast counter and easy-clean finishes planned around the classic work triangle.
body: An L-shaped kitchen with a tall unit, built-in appliances and a quartz island is planned around the work triangle. Soft-close hardware, under-cabinet task lights and easy-clean finishes make the space a pleasure to use every single day.

title: Bedroom Retreats: Warm Neutrals That Work
excerpt: A calm, clutter-free retreat in warm neutrals with upholstered textures and thoughtful lighting.
body: An upholstered bed wall, floating side tables and warm 3000K lighting make a bedroom feel like a boutique hotel. We keep surfaces clear and let texture — not clutter — carry the character of the room.

title: Designing a Focused Home Workspace
excerpt: A focused, client-ready workspace with acoustic pods and biophilic touches in oak, charcoal and brass.
body: Twelve-seat studio offices work best when daylight leads the plan. A director cabin, meeting pod and breakout zone are arranged around the windows, with oak, charcoal and brass adding warmth and a clear brand accent.
